description: 10 domain questions to compare Ody-trained model vs raw GPT-4 with all docs. The trained model should get these RIGHT because it has resolved contradictions.

questions.question: How many engineers are on the engineering team?
questions.whyBaselineFails: Raw LLM sees both 12 and 8, cannot determine which is current

questions.question: What is our API uptime SLA?
questions.whyBaselineFails: Both 99.99% and 99.9% appear in docs, no resolution context

questions.question: Is our company remote-first or office-required?
questions.correctAnswer: Remote-first with no mandatory office days
questions.whyBaselineFails: Contradictory policies exist, baseline hedges or picks wrong one

questions.question: What is the travel expense pre-approval threshold?
questions.whyBaselineFails: Two different thresholds in different docs ($500 vs $1000)

questions.question: When does V2 launch?
questions.whyBaselineFails: Original roadmap says Q2, board update says Q4, no recency signal

questions.question: Who owns the payment service?
questions.correctAnswer: Billing team handles payment service on-call
questions.whyBaselineFails: Team roster says Platform, on-call says Billing — conflicting ownership

questions.question: What is the max API rate limit per tenant?
questions.whyBaselineFails: Sales proposal says 10000, engineering says 1000 — baseline may pick the wrong number

questions.question: What deployment tool do we use?
questions.whyBaselineFails: Old guide says Jenkins, new says GitHub Actions — no versioning context

questions.question: What monitoring platform do we use?
questions.whyBaselineFails: Old doc says Datadog, new says Grafana — both present in context

questions.question: When is the database migration deadline?
questions.whyBaselineFails: Sprint retro says March, project status says June — conflicting deadlines
